items: Land in a wild area and, once they've had their look at you, all its young and grown-up animals come after you, however far you run, until you invite them or get knocked out. Invite them all and its runestone turns into a soundsystem.

In a wild area, a line under the clock says how many of its wild animals are still to invite (and how many are asleep or knocked down), and the last three get pointers, so you can find the ones out of sight and turn its runestone.
